So now it comes down to the NES or the SNES, which is an obvious no-brainer with SNES. The NES has a huge library of games with tons of classics, and they're challenging as hell. The NES offerers a totally different gaming experience. Gameplay on the NES tends to be more arcade oriented and skill based, which makes them more challenging. The reason I'd have to go with the SNES though is because a lot of the good NES games were either re-released or remade for the SNES, and so I'd still be getting a taste of NES by going with the Super Nintendo. To be honest with you, I can't even think of any NES games that I'd care about missing out on that aren't available on the SNES in one form or another. There's another good question. What games are available on the NES that don't have a similar counterpart on the SNES? Think about it for a minute and you'll see what I mean. Metroid? Check. CastlsVania? Check. Megaman? Check. Even the SMB games were released on the SNES as Super Mario All-stars. I truly can't think any games on the NES that don't exist on the SNES in one form or another.
